name: community/generics
description: Yaroslav Romanchenko's generic containers (parametric module) -- the earlier edition. std/data carries the same author's same containers as GenericCollections; new code should use that.
residual: G is a PARAMETRIC/generic module: compiles to a .SymUu interface but produces no .GofUu until instantiated. The package manager/build must treat generic modules as symbol-only (no object). GenericsUse.Mod is an instantiation example.
G.Mod itself is not in ocp/YR -- it came from its author, not from the tree, which is why the directory named as upstream accounts for three other modules and none of them is G.

Superseded by std/data on 2026-08-27. G and GenericCollections are the same set from the same author: MODULE G(TYPE T, CONST L) and MODULE GenericCollections(TYPE T, CONST Less), both with Container, Stack, Queue, DEQue and Vector, 399 lines against 419 -- GenericCollections adds a LinearContainer between Container and its descendants and spells the comparator out. The standard library picked one set of containers; this is kept rather than deleted because something may already name it, but it is not where new code should start.

excludes.GenericsUse: the instantiation example, kept in the tree rather than shipped
excludes.Ar: a package of its own: community/ar, Unix ar/deb archives, nothing to do with generics
excludes.SmallPT: a path tracer, and it needs Codecs (std/media) to write its image; a demo, not a library
